risk_note: RV2 (risk minimum-supported-version guard, stage ④a 10405; BR-ID-01 判定顺序 / 细则「受限会话」, 04 §5 x-min-version-gate / x-session-scopes, F1-02b minimum version reader). The guard runs after stages ①–③ for non-idempotent operations and at the idempotency post-miss hook for idempotent ones; the contract projection (min-version-routes.gen.ts) is generated, conditional exemptions follow the contract text (sms-codes / oauth-attempts / step-up / consents / abandon), a restricted (deletion_only) session may only call the allow-listed operations, and a reader failure never permits. Orchestrator ruling (approvals #18, 规划/11 §7.1): a restricted token on an x-auth none route is not checked — those routes are callable anonymously, so the check has no protective value; the planning inconsistency (08 restricted-session table vs 04 §5 none semantics) is recorded in couli-runs/B1-03c/spec-sync.md for the planning lane. Rebased onto main after B1-03d / B1-02g / B1-02m / B1-02f / CT-08d; the generated projection was regenerated. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21). Narrow fix after CI: entries without a reader (no database) do not gate (frozen B1-06e unit test stubs the open service on a database-less entry).

reviews.scope: independent read-only Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1 pool starvation via the post-miss read, S2 fail-closed timing), round 2 pass (S2×2), round 3 fail after the rebase (the pool starvation became reachable: openLink runs executeInTransaction on main), round 4 pass (post-miss read on the claim's own transaction via an AsyncLocalStorage context, no second pooled connection, per-request context isolation, frozen #22 order kept; S2 fail-closed timing recorded in followups; out-of-scope: restricted token on x-auth none routes per the orchestrator ruling, h5 principal scope, missing X-App-Version answered 20001 by the contract schema); round 5 (orchestrator-approved targeted review of the narrow fix) pass: an entry assembled without a minimum-version reader — no database, tests and contract smoke only — installs neither the ④a guard nor the post-miss hook and skips the fail-closed check (info log once); production / staging paths unaffected, a failing reader still never permits
